chapter.v:
The wise
woman builds her house,But the foolish pulls it down with her hands. [Gen. 10:10; 11:9; 2 Kin. 17:24; Is. 13:1; 47:1; Dan. 1:1; Rev. 14:8]

He who
walks in his uprightness fears the Lord,But he who is perverse in his ways despises Him. [Jer. 43:12,] [Is. 21:9 c Is. 46:1; Jer. 51:44]

In the
mouth of a fool is a rod of pride,But the lips of the wise will preserve them. [Jer. 51:48; Dan. 5:30, 31 f Is.]

Where no
oxen are, the trough is clean;But much increase comes by the strength of an ox. [Ezra 2:1; Is. 11:12, 13; Jer. 3:18; 31:31; 33:7; Hos. 1:11 h Ezra 3:12, 13; [Ps. 126:5]; Jer. 31:9; [Zech. 12:10]] [Hos. 3:5]

A faithful
witness does not lie,But a false witness will utter lies. [Jer. 31:31]

A scoffer
seeks wisdom and does not find it,But knowledge is easy to him who understands. [Is. 53:6; [Ezek. 34:15, 16]; Matt. 9:36; 10:6; 1 Pet. 2:25 l Jer. 23:1; Ezek. 34:2 m [Jer.]

Go from
the presence of a foolish man,When you do not perceive in him the lips of knowledge. [Ps. 79:7 o Jer. 40:2, 3; Zech. 11:5] [Ps. 22:4; Jer. 14:8;] [Jer. 2:3; Dan. 9:16 q [Ps. 90:1; 91:1]]

The wisdom
of the prudent is to understand his way,But the folly of fools is deceit. [Is. 48:20; Jer. 51:6, 45; Zech. 2:6, 7; [Rev. 18:4] Lord that they would not forget or reject (see Ezek. 16:60).]

Fools mock
at sin,But among the upright there is favor. [Jer. 15:14; 51:27 u]

The heart
knows its own bitterness,And a stranger does not share its joy. [[Rev. 17:16]]

The house
of the wicked will be overthrown,But the tent of the upright will flourish. [Jer. 51:29 a Jer.] [Is. 47:6 x Hos.]

There is
a way that seems right to a man,But its end is the way of death. [Jer. 51:43]

Even in
laughter the heart may sorrow,And the end of mirth may be grief. [Jer. 25:12 a Jer.]

The backslider
in heart will be filled with his own ways,But a good man will be satisfied from above. [Jer. 2:15 i 2 Kin. 15:29; 17:6; 18:9-13 j 2 Kin.] [Jer. 51:2]

The simple
believes every word,But the prudent considers well his steps. [1 Chr. 29:24; 2 Chr. 30:8; Lam. 5:6; Ezek. 17:18] [Jer. 51:58 e Jer.]

A wise
man fears and departs from evil,But a fool rages and is self-confident. [Is. 13:14; Jer.]

A quick-tempered
man acts foolishly,And a man of wicked intentions is hated. [2 Kin. 24:10,]

The simple
inherit folly,But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

The evil
will bow before the good,And the wicked at the gates of the righteous. [Is. 65:10; Jer. 33:12; Ezek. 34:13]

The poor
man is hated even by his own neighbor,But the rich has many friends. [Num. 23:21; Is. 43:25; [Jer. 31:34; Mic. 7:19]] [Is. 1:9]

He who
despises his neighbor sins;But he who has mercy on the poor, happy is he. [Ezek. 23:23 p]

Do they
not go astray who devise evil?But mercy and truth belong to those who devise good. [Jer. 51:54]

In all
labor there is profit,But idle chatter leads only to poverty. [Is. 14:6; Jer.]

The crown
of the wise is their riches,But the foolishness of fools is folly. [Jer. 51:8, 31; Dan. 5:30 t [Is.]

A true
witness delivers souls,But a deceitful witness speaks lies. [Is. 13:5]

In the
fear of the Lord there is strong confidence,And His children will have a place of refuge.

The fear
of the Lord is a fountain of life,To turn one away from the snares of death. [Ps. 37:13; Jer. 48:44; Ezek. 7:7] [Ps. 22:12; Is. 34:7; Jer. 46:21]

In a
multitude of people is a king’s honor,But in the lack of people is the downfall of a prince. [Ps. 149:6-9; Jer. 51:10]

He who
is slow to wrath has great understanding,But he who is impulsive exalts folly. [Ps. 137:8; Jer. 51:56; [2 Thess. 1:6]; Rev. 18:6 z [Is.]

A sound
heart is life to the body,But envy is rottenness to the bones. [Is. 13:18; Jer.]

He who
oppresses the poor reproaches his Maker,But he who honors Him has mercy on the needy.

The wicked
is banished in his wickedness,But the righteous has a refuge in his death. [Is. 26:5; Mal. 4:1 c Jer. 21:14]

Wisdom rests
in the heart of him who has understanding,But what is in the heart of fools is made known.

Righteousness exalts
a nation,But sin is a reproach to any people. [Prov. 23:11; Is. 43:14; Jer. 15:21; 31:11; Rev. 18:8 e Is. 47:4 f Jer. 51:36; Mic. 7:9]

The king’s
favor is toward a wise servant,But his wrath is against him who causes shame. [Dan. 5:30 h Is. 47:13; Jer. 51:57 (see 2 Chr. 36:22, 23; Is. 45:1). (see Is. 47:4), offers to obtain the legal freedom of His people]
